layers.authority: Junta de Extremadura (Monfragüe National Park, PRUG Decreto 79/2025)
layers.process: Under the park's use and management plan (Decreto 79/2025 of 15 July, published DOE 21 July 2025), commercial photography, filming and recording inside Monfragüe National Park is an extraordinary activity that needs authorisation, and drone use is not authorisable for it. Motor vehicles may use the EX-208, the Bazagona road, the Monfragüe Castle access road and the open traditional-settlement zones; the Cañada Real Trujillana section needs a declaración responsable (a signed self-declaration) and the Serrejón-Serradilla track needs authorisation.

sources.title: Decreto 79/2025, Plan Rector de Uso y Gestión del Parque Nacional de Monfragüe

laws.rule: Monfragüe National Park's management plan (Decreto 79/2025) bans overflight of the park by aircraft including drones, kites and balloons from ground to flight level 90 (9,000 ft), except rescue and similar missions.
laws.heading: Decreto 79/2025, art. on incompatible uses (DOE 139, 21 July 2025)

laws.rule: Monfragüe National Park bans free camping in any form, including sleeping in caravans or vehicles outside authorised lodging, lighting open fires, rock climbing, fishing and hunting. Motor traffic is allowed only on the listed roads.
laws.heading: Decreto 79/2025, Plan Rector de Uso y Gestión (DOE 139, 21 July 2025)

laws.rule: In Extremadura it is banned to light a fire in forest land and in the forest influence zone around it, except in cases the fire law expressly allows or authorises, and to throw or leave burning objects or anything that could start a fire (article 39(1) of Ley 5/2004). Walking in forest areas can be limited or banned when fire danger needs it (article 39(2)). The regional minister sets the dates of the high, medium and low danger seasons each year by order (article 6). Fines run from EUR 100 to 1,000 for minor breaches (about A$159 to A$1,589 at EUR 0.6293 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026), EUR 1,001 to 100,000 for serious and EUR 100,001 to 1,000,000 for very serious (article 83); which band a given act falls in was not read.
laws.heading: Ley 5/2004, de 24 de junio, de prevención y lucha contra los incendios forestales en Extremadura, arts 6, 39 and 83 (BOE consolidated)

laws.rule: Extremadura's leisure and coexistence law bans drinking alcohol in streets and public areas (vías y zonas públicas), except in leisure spaces a council has expressly authorised (article 15.1). The ban does not touch licensed festivals such as patron-saint fairs, which have their own permits (15.2). Selling or serving alcohol to anyone under 18 is banned anywhere in Extremadura (article 8) and under-18s may not drink (article 9). Shops that are not for on-the-spot drinking may not sell alcohol from 22:00 to 07:00 (article 13.4). Breaking the street-drinking rule is a serious infringement (article 23), with a fine of EUR 300 to EUR 30,000 (about A$477 to A$47,672 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293). Councils enforce it.
